text.arabic_uthmani: وَمَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥٓ إِذَا تَرَدَّىٰٓ

words.gloss_range: opening connector that carries the prior negative branch into the wealth-futility verdict

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the negator immediately following the connector

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) keeps 92:11 attached to the portrait of the miserly, self-sufficient denier in 92:8-10. The wealth clause therefore lands as a consequence and exhibit, not as a detached proverb about money, and it also describes the condition surrounding the coming fall. Because the connector runs directly into {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:ma}}), the ayah enters through a clipped continuation-into-negation: the prior verdict carries straight into the denial that wealth will avail.

topics.headline: opening connector carries the prior consequence forward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears 92:11 as the next step in the bad-branch arc from 92:8-10, not as a new isolated maxim.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as a conjunction, and the attachment evidence keeps the following suffixes and subject chain tied to the same prior participant.

topics.headline: continuation with circumstantial pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can feel the clause both advancing the verdict and describing the state in which the fall is disclosed.
topics.reason: The local tag supports conjunction first; the circumstantial value survives as pressure because the ayah immediately states the condition under which the prior fate becomes visible.

topics.headline: connector enters as a bound launch into negation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that continuation is heard before and inside the negation, so the denial begins as linked follow-through.
topics.reason: The surface sequence joins the connector directly to the negator while QAC still identifies the connector as its own particle.

words.gloss_range: negative particle placing the whole availing predication under factual denial

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the imperfect availing verb governed by the negation
the delayed subject whose efficacy has already been denied

words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:ma}}) negates the whole verbal claim: {{ar:يُغْنِى}} ({{tr:yughni}}), its governed beneficiary, and the delayed subject {{ar:مَالُهُۥٓ}} ({{tr:maluhu}}). Because it governs an imperfect indicative verb, the denial is factual and open-ended rather than a prohibition or a past-only report. The short particle onset lets the denial strike before the heavier root-word unfolds. The word also front-loads the reversal of the earlier self-sufficiency claim in 92:8; before wealth is even named, its supposed saving function has already been placed inside futility.

topics.headline: negation scopes over the availing predication
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah denies the efficacy of the entire wealth-availing event, not merely one noun phrase.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the particle as negative, and attachment evidence marks the first clause as the negated main verbal clause.

topics.headline: factual denial rather than command or question
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a settled statement of impossibility at the crisis, not an instruction, wish, or open question.
topics.reason: The following verb is an imperfect indicative under a negative particle, so the clause states factual non-availing.

topics.headline: wealth arrives after its failure has begun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the collapse of claimed sufficiency before the noun for wealth finally appears.
topics.reason: The negation and verb precede the nominative subject, and the same root field as 92:8 is now introduced under negation.

topics.headline: short particles make a clipped negative entry
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a quick linked denial before the heavier root-word unfolds.
topics.reason: The surface onset combines the connector and negator before the longer imperfect verb.

words.gloss_range: negated Form IV availing or sufficing, with wealth as subject and an affected person governed through the preposition
words.root_gloss_range: sufficiency, wealth, availing, benefit, replacement, dwelling, song, and other branches; the local Form IV construction selects availing or sufficing while nonmaterial branches remain outside the local sense

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the governed prepositional complement naming the protected party
the delayed subject whose ability to avail is denied

words.prose: {{ar:يُغْنِى}} ({{tr:yughni}}) is the ayah's main test-word: can the possessed wealth actually suffice, protect, or avail? The local frame answers no. The verb has no direct object here; it works with {{ar:عَنْهُ}} ({{tr:anhu}}), so the failure is personal, aimed at the very man for whom protection would be expected. Its Form IV imperfect makes the issue active capability, not mere status, and the clause-bound pairing with {{ar:مَالُهُۥٓ}} ({{tr:maluhu}}) forces wealth and sufficiency into one failed-rescue verdict. Its same-root return from 92:8 reverses the earlier self-sufficiency claim: what the man treated as independence cannot confer sufficiency when the fall arrives. The two-beat structure states the rule and then exposes it in the when-clause, before 92:12 shifts reliability from failed material sufficiency to guidance held with God. Broader root branches such as song or dwelling are real in the dictionary range but are not selected by this availing construction.

topics.headline: availing is aimed toward a governed person
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the failure is not abstract; it is failure to protect or suffice for the named person.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the verb with no direct object and a governed prepositional complement, matching the dictionary construction for availing or sufficing.

topics.headline: causative capability is denied
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that wealth is tested as an active source of sufficiency, and that very capacity is what the ayah denies.
topics.reason: QAC marks a Form IV imperfect indicative, and contextual evidence shows this form is frequently negated in sufficiency or availing contexts.

topics.headline: earlier self-sufficiency is reversed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the same sufficiency root return from 92:8, but now as the objective failure of what the man claimed.
topics.reason: The root alignment links this verb with the same-root self-sufficiency claim in 92:8 while the local form shifts from self-assessment to conferred availing.

topics.headline: wealth and sufficiency are clause-bound
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the wealth-root and sufficiency-root forced into one verdict: the named wealth is excluded from the saving role.
topics.reason: The delayed noun is the subject of this verb, so the cooccurrence is local syntax rather than a loose thematic association.

topics.headline: broader root branches are not selected here
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the local availing sense clear while recognizing that the root's wider dictionary range should not be imported into this clause.
topics.reason: V4 separates availing from song, dwelling, and other branches, while the local construction selects the availing or sufficing branch.

topics.headline: negated efficacy becomes visible at the crisis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the verb states the rule whose truth is exposed in the following when-clause, before 92:12 shifts the reliable locus to guidance.
topics.reason: The main negated clause is followed by a temporal clause, and the next ayah opens a contrasting guidance assertion in 92:12.

words.gloss_range: preposition plus third-person suffix naming the affected person from whom need or harm is not averted

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the availing verb that governs the prepositional complement
the possessive wealth noun sharing the same suffix sound

words.prose: {{ar:عَنْهُ}} ({{tr:anhu}}) tells where the expected protection fails. The preposition is not a loose separation marker here; it is governed by {{ar:يُغْنِى}} ({{tr:yughni}}), making the man the affected beneficiary from whom ruin or need would have to be averted. Its separation and behalf senses converge: wealth neither keeps ruin away from him nor stands in effectively for him. The attached suffix keeps him identical with the participant of 92:8-10, and its sound prepares {{ar:مَالُهُۥٓ}} ({{tr:maluhu}}): the man and his wealth are audibly bound even as the sentence denies that the wealth can act for him.

topics.headline: preposition marks the protected party
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees exactly whose protection fails: the clause marks the man as the party wealth cannot avail for.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the suffix as the governed complement of the availing verb through the preposition.

topics.headline: suffix continues the prior participant
topics.reader_payoff: The reader follows the same unnamed man from 92:8-10 into the wealth-futility scene without needing him renamed.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence links this suffix, the possessive suffix, and the implicit subject of the final verb to the same prior masculine singular participant.

topics.headline: relation and referent are fused in one word
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the failed-beneficiary role and the coming possessive wealth as one tight referential chain.
topics.reason: The preposition and suffix form one surface word, and the following wealth noun repeats the same third-person suffix.

words.gloss_range: his personally possessed wealth, treated as the delayed subject whose power to avail is denied
words.root_gloss_range: wealth, property, possessions, acquired resources, and livestock-as-wealth; locally the possessed stockpile is made syntactic subject but denied saving efficacy

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the availing verb for which the wealth is subject
the governed person for whom the wealth fails to avail

words.prose: {{ar:مَالُهُۥٓ}} ({{tr:maluhu}}) arrives late as the nominative subject of {{ar:يُغْنِى}} ({{tr:yughni}}), after its failure has already been announced. The possessive suffix makes the wealth specifically his, and the singular mass-like noun gathers the whole tangible stockpile into one tested resource. That is the irony: a concrete possession is promoted to grammatical agent only to show that possession cannot become rescue. It also makes the hardship of 92:10 material: the thing he relied on becomes the exhibit of uselessness at the fall. Within the surah, the same wealth-axis turns in opposite directions: the withheld resource of 92:8 is useless here, while wealth given in 92:18 moves toward purification.

topics.headline: his wealth is the delayed failed subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader watches the expected rescuer arrive only after grammar has already placed it under failure.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the noun as a definite possessive nominative subject of the availing verb.

topics.headline: the resource is personally his
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the failure lands on the man's own attached resource, not on wealth as a detached abstraction.
topics.reason: The possessive suffix makes the noun definite by construct and links it to the same prior participant.

topics.headline: static wealth is tested as an agent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the mismatch between a static possession and the active rescue role assigned to it.
topics.reason: The root evidence is nominal and concrete, while local syntax makes the noun the subject of the verb whose efficacy is denied.

topics.headline: wealth is concrete accumulated property
topics.reader_payoff: The reader pictures accumulated tangible resources failing at the fall, not merely social status losing prestige.
topics.reason: V4 gives the local root branch as wealth, property, and acquired resources, which fits the possessive noun.

topics.headline: wealth is excluded from rescue
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the prior hardship made concrete as the failure of the very resource he relied on.
topics.reason: The wealth noun is clause-bound to the negated availing verb and therefore functions as the concrete exhibit of non-rescue.

topics.headline: retained wealth contrasts with given wealth
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees wealth become a moral fork inside the surah: retained into ruin here, given toward purification in 92:18.
topics.reason: The same wealth noun recurs in the surah with opposed moral movement, and the 92:8 withholding background sharpens the local irony.

topics.headline: suffix sound binds man and wealth
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the man and his wealth tightly linked even as the clause denies any saving power in that link.
topics.reason: The possessive suffix is fused to the noun and echoes the prior suffix in the prepositional complement.

words.gloss_range: temporal-conditional particle introducing the certain crisis moment when wealth's failure is disclosed

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the perfect fall verb that fills the when-clause

words.prose: {{ar:إِذَا}} ({{tr:idha}}) turns the denial of wealth's efficacy into a timed scene. With the perfect verb {{ar:تَرَدَّىٰٓ}} ({{tr:taradda}}), it reads as a future-certain when, not an open-ended if: the fall is treated as the assured moment when the truth of the negated clause becomes visible. Structurally, the particle is the hinge between the general verdict and its crisis-point, converting the hardship of 92:10 into an event the listener can locate.

topics.headline: the when-clause carries certainty
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the fall as an assured disclosure point rather than a merely possible scenario.
topics.reason: QAC marks the particle as temporal-conditional and the following verb as perfect, matching the CRITICAL claim about future-certain timing.

topics.headline: particle hinges verdict and scene
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah split into a denial and the exact event that manifests it.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the particle and final verb a temporal clause attached to the negated availing event.

topics.headline: prior hardship becomes a fall-moment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the prior easing toward hardship in 92:10 with the concrete moment when wealth proves useless.
topics.reason: The temporal clause specifies the scene in which the previous consequence is exhibited.

words.gloss_range: Form V perfect fall or perish in a self-involved ruin scene after the temporal particle
words.root_gloss_range: falling into ruin, perishing, causing destruction, casting down, and mantle-wearing branches, with other stone, gait, increase, and cajoling branches outside the local selection

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the particle that makes the perfect verb future-certain

words.prose: {{ar:تَرَدَّىٰٓ}} ({{tr:taradda}}) is where the ayah lands. After {{ar:إِذَا}} ({{tr:idha}}), the perfect form presents the fall as a future-certain event, and the hidden third-person masculine subject keeps it attached to the same man from 92:8-10. The Form V shape makes the ruin self-involved rather than a neutral report of death or an externally hurled collapse. Its root field gives the final scene a concrete downward image: he falls or perishes at the point where wealth cannot lift or rescue him. The rare fatal-fall field is sharpened by the fallen-animal occurrence in 5:3, while the local scene remains this man's ruin. The fall also answers same-surah movement: it shows where misguided striving in 92:4 leads, echoes the self-sufficiency cadence of 92:8 as collapse, and is followed by the guidance counter-axis in 92:12. The mantle branch survives only as narrowed image-pressure, making the ruin feel like a consequence he has put on himself; as a further extension, the word can model collapse below rescue without replacing the human subject. The verse-final long ending and doubled consonant let the fall occupy the acoustic close.

topics.headline: perfect fall continues the same man
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the fall as the assured future crisis of the same participant traced from 92:8-10.
topics.reason: QAC marks a perfect third-person masculine verb, and attachment evidence identifies the unexpressed subject as continuing the same discourse participant.

topics.headline: Form V makes the ruin self-involved
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the man is not grammatically cast as a passive victim; the form places him inside his own collapse.
topics.reason: The local verb is active Form V and intransitive, not a passive or a causative form with an external hurler.

topics.headline: fall image becomes terminal ruin
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the end as a concrete downward ruin, not only as an abstract moral decline.
topics.reason: V4 includes a falling-into-ruin branch, and the local when-clause makes that branch the scene of disclosed non-availing.

topics.headline: selected form avoids external hurling
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears ruin as the man's own movement into consequence rather than as a form chosen to say another agent threw him down.
topics.reason: The local Form V perfect is distinct from simple perishing or causative destruction forms in the root range.

topics.headline: mantle sense survives as image pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can feel ruin as something the man has wrapped around himself, while the local sense remains falling or perishing.
topics.reason: V4 preserves the mantle branch, including the same surface form in dictionary evidence, but local syntax and context select the ruin or fall branch as the governing sense.

topics.headline: systemic collapse remains an extension
topics.reader_payoff: The reader may recognize the fall as a model of collapse below rescue, while the local referent remains the man's ruin.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence supplies a human third-person subject; systemic collapse can illustrate the mechanism but cannot replace the local referent.

topics.headline: rare root concentrates fatal-fall texture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a marked rare root at the endpoint, with the fallen-animal occurrence in 5:3 intensifying fatal plunge texture.
topics.reason: The contextual profile marks the local form as low-occurrence, and the CRITICAL rows give the concrete 5:3 comparison without making it control the local parse.

topics.headline: fall closes the ayah as disclosure scene
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah does not end on wealth; it ends on the fall that proves wealth's non-availing.
topics.reason: The final word sits inside the temporal clause that supplies the scene where the main denial is manifested.

topics.headline: fall answers prior and following surah movements
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the final fall with diverse striving in 92:4, self-sufficiency in 92:8, and the guidance assertion that follows in 92:12.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows supply concrete same-surah references, and the local final position makes the echoes relevant without overriding the local verb sense.

topics.headline: doubled sound and long ending carry the close
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears and sees the fall-word as heavy and prolonged at the verse boundary.
topics.reason: The surface shows doubled consonantal marking and a verse-final long open ending, which supports the acoustic close without changing the lexical sense.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The negated sufficing verb governs the possessive wealth noun, while the temporal descent clause names the point at which sufficiency is tested.
baseline_models.mechanism: The availing-and-replacing branch of the first focus root is denied to acquired property at the falling-into-ruin branch of the final root. Possessions cannot function as a proxy for the possessor across irreversible collapse.

activation_trace.role: Sufficing, benefiting, and standing in for another supply the exact function that the focus negates.
Acquired property supplies the stock that is expected, but fails, to serve as substitute.
A fall into ruin supplies the irreversible threshold at which substitution is exposed as impossible.

changed_reading.before: His wealth will not benefit him when he dies.
changed_reading.after: At irreversible collapse, owned capital cannot spare, replace, or stand in for its owner; the denial concerns substitution, not merely usefulness.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus places a self-sufficiency root beside a wealth root and then subjects both to a collapse condition.
baseline_models.mechanism: The near-doubling of wealth and independence constructs an attempted identity: the owner treats having property as being without need. Descent reveals that the two are not equivalent, because possession cannot remove the owner's terminal dependence.

activation_trace.role: Wealth and freedom from need supply the identity the owner implicitly expects property to confer.
Accumulated possessions materialize the attempted self-sufficient identity.
Ruin functions as the stress test that uncovers dependence beneath apparent independence.

changed_reading.before: A rich person loses the advantage of riches at the end.
changed_reading.after: The collapse disproves a category error: having wealth never made the owner self-sufficient, even while it made him appear so.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: A focus branch links the sufficiency root to settled dwelling, while the descent root includes disappearance in an unknown direction.
baseline_models.mechanism: Property stabilizes a household and records that its owner once dwelt there, but it remains spatially fixed when the owner departs. The possessive expression becomes ironic: what was 'his' turns into a surviving habitation-marker that cannot accompany him.

activation_trace.role: Long dwelling and former habitation turn sufficiency into the stable place a life leaves behind.
Possessions furnish and mark the settled place but remain exterior to the departing owner.
Disappearance toward an unknown direction breaks the link between owner and fixed habitation.

changed_reading.before: Wealth is left behind at death.
changed_reading.after: The owner's settled world survives only as evidence that he once inhabited it; its very staying power shows why it cannot accompany or avail him.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The final focus root carries both ruin and a rushing or bounding gait, allowing the temporal clause to be heard as motion before impact.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus can stage not only a passive fall but an already accelerated course. Wealth may finance movement, yet it supplies neither steering nor braking and therefore cannot alter the destination of headlong momentum.

activation_trace.role: Rushing, bounding, and heavy gait supply an embodied trajectory rather than a motionless terminal state.
The denied capacity to avail becomes, functionally, a denied capacity to arrest or redirect the course.
Accumulated means can propel activity but do not themselves provide orientation or restraint.

changed_reading.before: The owner eventually falls despite being rich.
changed_reading.after: The owner is already moving headlong; wealth can add means to motion but cannot brake the trajectory when it becomes ruinous.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening alternation between concealment and disclosure activates the mantle branch of the focus descent root. Wealth can operate as a social covering that makes dependence look like sufficiency; collapse is the moment the cover is stripped and its inability to protect becomes visible.

activation_trace.role: Darkness supplies an environment in which underlying condition can remain unseen.
A covering that rises over and hides something supplies the active veil in the mechanism.
Daylight opening supplies the counter-movement from concealment to inspectability.
Disclosure and emergence make the hidden inadequacy of the covering manifest.
A worn mantle and what clings to the shoulders anchor the covering image directly in the focus clause.
Denied sufficiency distinguishes an impressive cover from actual protection.

structural_cues: The paired opening clauses move from covering to disclosure before the focus places negation at a temporal threshold.
The possessive wealth noun sits between denied sufficiency and the focus root that can also name a mantle.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealment, disclosure, wealth, and a mantle/fall polysemy. I infer that wealth is the cover exposed by collapse. A live alternative is that the cosmic alternation supplies only contrast, while the focus retains literal ruin without an unveiling mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Wealth fails when its owner falls.
changed_reading.after: Wealth first conceals dependence like a mantle; the fall is also an unveiling in which apparent sufficiency is exposed as non-protective.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measured formation, purposeful work, and divergent courses recast the focus fall as the terminus of a trajectory rather than an isolated accident. Wealth stores the yield of striving, but stored yield cannot determine the direction in which the striver's course resolves.

activation_trace.role: Measuring and proportioning supply a designed field within which different courses can be compared.
Purposeful movement toward an objective supplies direction and agency to the trajectory.
Work, earning, and transaction connect the course to the production of wealth without equating proceeds with direction.
Dispersion supplies multiple outcomes and prevents one undifferentiated model of striving.
Bounding motion anchors the contextual courses in the focus body's own movement.
Acquired property becomes the stored residue of work, not a steering mechanism.

structural_cues: A creation clause is followed by an explicit assertion that human striving diverges.
The focus later tests wealth at the endpoint of motion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measure, purposeful work, dispersion, and rushing motion. I infer that wealth is an output of a course but cannot choose that course's end. A live alternative is that wealth and trajectory are parallel moral facts rather than a production-and-steering contrast.

changed_reading.before: A wealthy person meets an externally imposed fall.
changed_reading.after: The fall is the resolution of a directed course: wealth may be what striving accumulated, yet accumulation cannot steer the striver away from the course he made.

context_deltas.mechanism: Giving, self-protection, enacted truth, beneficence, and opened ease form a conversion chain. Money does not avail as retained stock or substitute, but it can be translated through outward transfer into protective conduct and a newly opened course.

activation_trace.role: Handing something over supplies the outward transfer that breaks mere possession.
Placing oneself within protection supplies the function toward which giving is ordered.
Making a promise true in action prevents assent from remaining an inert claim.
A monetary due or charitable transfer links enacted truth directly to material wealth.
Doing what is good supplies the qualitative transformation of the transferred asset.
An opening into ease after difficulty supplies the changed course produced by the conversion.
Denied availing blocks the shortcut in which retained property itself performs the protective work.
Owned stock is the same material whose function changes only when it enters action.

structural_cues: The ordered conditional sequence moves from giving and guarding through enacted confirmation to facilitation.
The focus negation later targets wealth while it remains grammatically possessed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies transfer, protection, enacted truth, good action, and ease. I infer a functional arrow in which outward transfer converts wealth into protective conduct. A live alternative is that these are coordinated traits rather than successive stages in one conversion.

changed_reading.before: Money is categorically useless at collapse.
changed_reading.after: Money cannot substitute for its owner as retained stock, but before collapse it can be converted through giving into a protective pattern of action.

context_deltas.mechanism: The direct recurrence of the self-sufficiency root after withholding turns the focus into an internal contradiction. The one who withholds because he imagines himself beyond need makes wealth carry a function it cannot perform; terminal non-availing reveals a failure already present in the posture of possession.

activation_trace.role: Withholding supplies the practical form taken by the claim of independence.
Claimed wealth and freedom from need supply the posture that the focus later tests.
The availing sense turns the claim of independence into an expectation that possessions can suffice for the self.
The repeated root now negates the very sufficiency claimed earlier.
Possessive wealth identifies the hoard on which the self-sufficiency claim depends.
Ruin is the final disclosure of the hoard's prior inability to abolish need.

structural_cues: The same root occurs first in a positive self-description and then in a negated question about wealth.
The withholding sequence is the antithesis of the earlier giving sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies withholding, a claim of independence, a repeated sufficiency root, and collapse. I infer that the later negation answers and unmasks the earlier claim. A live alternative is that the recurrence is emphatic contrast without implying that failure began before collapse.

changed_reading.before: Wealth stops helping only when ruin arrives.
changed_reading.after: The hoard was never self-sufficiency: withholding enacted a false independence whose terminal non-availing merely makes the contradiction undeniable.

context_deltas.mechanism: A garment that misrepresents its wearer's condition activates the focus mantle branch, while twisting difficulty supplies constriction. Wealth becomes a status-garment that advertises independence but cannot protect the wearer; wrapping oneself in it can even tighten the difficult course.

activation_trace.role: A garment whose appearance lies about its condition supplies a concrete model of deceptive exterior display.
Twisting, obstruction, and imposed difficulty turn the apparent covering into constriction rather than shelter.
Putting on a mantle anchors the garment mechanism in the focus verb while remaining a coexisting, form-distant reading.
Denied sufficiency exposes the difference between looking protected and actually being protected.
Visible possessions supply the wearable social exterior in the analogy.

structural_cues: Denial is followed by facilitation toward difficulty and then by the focus's mantle-or-fall clause.
The focus wealth noun is possessive, making the covering something the owner has chosen to identify as his.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a deceptive garment, twisting difficulty, and a mantle branch in the focus. I infer that wealth is worn as a misleading status-cover. A live alternative is that the garment branch is only a remote lexical resonance and that the sequence concerns denial followed by literal ruin.

changed_reading.before: The rich owner falls despite his possessions.
changed_reading.after: He has wrapped himself in possessions as a status-garment; at the crisis, the garment's promise of independence is revealed as a constricting lie.

context_deltas.mechanism: The split guidance inventory places gentle direction beside a steep descent, and the following first/later language expands the time horizon. The focus fall becomes a path-condition with an origin, direction, and outcome; wealth has no directional or escorting capacity across that whole arc.

activation_trace.role: Gentle direction toward a road supplies the positive alternative to uncontrolled descent.
The non-dominant mapped inventory contributes a difficult downhill passage, giving the path a steep topography.
What comes after supplies the far endpoint against which present possessions are tested.
Return to outcome or eventual resolution binds beginning and end into one trajectory.
Falling into a pit or ruin anchors the steep contextual route in the focus event.
Non-availing means that wealth cannot serve as guide, escort, or replacement across the route.

structural_cues: Immediately after the focus, guidance is assigned and both temporal endpoints are claimed.
The packet preserves two mapped inventories for the guidance cue, allowing direction and steep descent to coexist.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gentle guidance, a split-root steep descent, temporal endpoints, and the focus fall. I infer one route extending from origin to outcome. A live alternative is that the steep-descent image is mapping resonance rather than a mechanism intended by the context word.

changed_reading.before: Wealth fails at one terminal instant.
changed_reading.after: Wealth cannot orient or escort the owner along the whole route from beginning to outcome; the terminal fall reveals a prior absence of guidance on a steep course.

context_deltas.mechanism: A runner following another, a turn away, and movement to the side activate the focus's rushing gait. The sequence becomes a race-like spatial system of following, orientation, and lateral removal: wealth cannot change lane or brake, whereas direction determines whether the moving person enters danger or is shifted aside.

activation_trace.role: The runner immediately behind the leader supplies a sequential course in which position follows prior motion.
Turning away supplies the decisive reorientation within the moving course.
Being kept apart or moved away supplies lateral escape from the dangerous line.
A shield positioned at the side makes lateral removal protective rather than merely distant.

reader_b.activated_readings_md:
1. **Wealth failing as substitute.** Evidence: `غ ن ي` B002 (sufficing/availing/replacing), `م و ل` B001 (wealth/property), `ر د ي` B003 (falling into ruin). Structural cue: 92:8 claimed self-sufficiency; this ayah negates its instrument. Mechanism: money is tested as a stand-in and cannot accompany the falling self. Abductive move: I infer a moment of need in which stored wealth is asked to function as rescue. Reading change: the ayah is not general poverty-of-wealth; it is failed substitution at the instant of collapse.

2. **Falling as mantle reversed.** Evidence: `ر د ي` B004 (mantle/clinging to shoulders), activated by 92:1 covering and 92:17 being kept aside from fire. Structural cue: the verb can evoke both falling and being wrapped. Mechanism: what clung as property/cover becomes unable to clothe or shield. Abductive move: I infer a reversal from protective covering to ruinous draping. Reading change: “تردى” can be read as collapse into the very covering one trusted.

3. **Stone/weight imagery of descent.** Evidence: `ر د ي` B001 (stone throwing/rock), B002 (heavy trampling/bounding gait), activated by `ع ل و` highness in 92:20. Structural cue: the sequence moves from wealth to falling, then later to the Highest. Mechanism: amassed property behaves like downward mass rather than upward rank. Abductive move: I infer gravitational moral physics: misplaced weight pulls down. Reading change: wealth is not neutral cargo; it can become the stone-weight of descent.
reader_b.retrospective_surprises_md: The later fire section surprised me by making `غ ش و` more than darkness: 92:14-17 creates a cover/contact/avoidance geometry. Night’s covering now anticipates both dangerous engulfing and the need to be moved aside from the blaze.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Possession cannot substitute for the possessor.** `يُغْنِى` anchors `غ ن ي:B002` (sufficing, availing, and standing in), `مَالُهُ` anchors `م و ل:B001` (acquired wealth), and `تَرَدَّىٰ` anchors `ر د ي:B003` (falling into ruin). The sequence explicitly places wealth in the attempted functional role of arresting or replacing its owner at the moment of descent, then negates that role. The minimal inference is that “availing” is being tested as support, while the packet directly supplies the negation and fall. The ayah reads as a failed substitution mechanism, not merely a statement that wealth is generally useless.

2. **The mantle that clings but does not catch.** The form `تَرَدَّىٰ` also activates `ر د ي:B004` (putting on a mantle and what clings to the shoulders), a branch whose scope includes debt as something attached to the neck. Possessive `مَالُهُ`, followed within the window by warning, fire, denial, and turning away in 92:14–16, makes the clothing image materially coherent: what is possessed can remain wrapped around a person while offering no arresting support. This is an exploratory double image; falling is the primary construction, and the mantle reading does not replace it. It changes the scene from simple dispossession to a sharper irony—wealth may cling through the fall yet still fail to bear its owner.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 92:14–16 turned the fall from an isolated accident into the terminus of warning, encounter, denial, and withdrawal. Those later ayat also made the mantle branch `ر د ي:B004` surprisingly apt: possession may remain attached while the person loses direction and support, though the falling branch `B003` remains primary.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, sahip olunan değerli varlıkları ve bunların çoğulunu; kişinin kendisi için varlık edinmesini, varlığının çoğalmasını ya da varlıklı duruma gelmesini ve başkasını varlık sahibi kılmasını birlikte aktarır. Göçebe toplulukların varlığının hayvan sürüleriyle somutlaşması bu çekirdeğin bağlama bağlı bir özelleşmesidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca para ya da birikmiş değer değildir; varlığın kendisini, edinilmesini, artmasını, varlıklı duruma geçişi ve başkasına varlık kazandırmayı ayırarak kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, genel varlık ve varlık edinme çekirdeğini ayrı tutar; göçebe toplulukların hayvan sürülerini varlık sayan kullanımını yalnızca belirli bir söz öbeğine bağlı özelleşme olarak sınırlar.

concept_map.definition: Kişinin sahip olduğu değerli varlıkların bütünü ile bunları edinme, çoğaltma ya da bunlara sahip duruma gelme alanıdır. Ayrıca başkasını varlık sahibi kılmayı kapsar; göçebe topluluklara özgü kullanımda sahip olunan varlık özellikle hayvan sürüleridir.

facets.statement: Kişinin sahip olduğu ve değer taşıyan varlıkların bütünü bu dalın ad çekirdeğini oluşturur.
Göçebe toplulukların varlığına ilişkin belirli kullanımda bu varlık, hayvan sürüleriyle somutlaşır.
Kişinin kendisi için değerli varlık edinmesi ve onu kalıcı sahiplik konusu yapması eylem çekirdeğidir.
Kişinin varlığının çoğalması ya da onun varlık sahibi bir duruma geçmesi ayrı bir süreç görünümüdür.
Bir başkasına değerli varlık vererek onu varlık sahibi duruma getirmek, çekirdeğin ettirgen uzantısıdır.
Bir kimsenin varlığının çokluğuna şaşma bildiren söyleyiş, artış ve bolluk görünümüne bağlı bir kullanımdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların toplu anlatımı, sahip olunan değerli varlıkları ve bunların çoğulunu temel alır; varlık edinme, varlığın çoğalması, varlıklı duruma gelme ve başkasını varlık sahibi kılma süreçlerini bu temel çevresinde birleştirir. Hayvan sürüleri göçebe topluluklara özgü somutlaşma, çokluk karşısındaki şaşma söyleyişi ise bağlı bir kullanım olarak aktarılır. Mal adının küçültme biçimi de ayrıca kaydedilir.
